mapper.sql: select m.id, m.project_id, m.researcher_id, m.month, m.total_rd_hours, m.cumulative_hours, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u2.nick_name as researcher_name, p.project_no, p.project_name from rd_worktime_monthly m join project p on m.project_id = p.project_id join sys_user u2 on m.researcher_id = u2.user_id left join sys_dept d on p.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user u on p.leader_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select id, project_id, researcher_id, month, total_rd_hours, cumulative_hours, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from rd_worktime_monthly where project_id = #{projectId} and month = #{month} and total_rd_hours > 0 and del_flag = '0' order by researcher_id

select m.id, m.project_id, m.researcher_id, m.month, m.total_rd_hours, m.cumulative_hours, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, su.nick_name as researcher_name from rd_worktime_monthly m left join sys_user su on m.researcher_id = su.user_id where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.month = #{month} and m.total_rd_hours > 0 and m.del_flag = '0' and m.researcher_id = #{selfUserId} order by m.researcher_id
